Mirwaiz calls for India-Pakistan dialogue, citing US-Iran example

Kashmir's chief cleric, Mirwaiz Umar Farooq, has reiterated his call for India and Pakistan to resume dialogue to resolve longstanding issues, including the Kashmir conflict. He drew a parallel with the US and Iran's ability to engage in talks, suggesting India and Pakistan could do the same. The statements come amid reports of a potential track-two dialogue and a meeting between an RSS leader and Pakistani officials, which has drawn political scrutiny.
